verses.1: A song for David to sing.
verses.2: God will raise up those who are His enemies, and He will cast out those who hate Him from before His face.
verses.3: As smoke is destroyed by fire, so do the wicked perish before God.
verses.4: And the righteous will rejoice, they will be glad in the presence of God, and they will be full of joy.
verses.5: Sing to the God; chant His name. Let us ride in the chaos of the night, with His name upon us, and let us stand before Him.
verses.6: My father is Yethomim and Dayan Almanto. God is holy in His holiness.
verses.7: God brings back those who are alone, and He releases prisoners from their prisons. But those who have sinned must be punished.
verses.8: God, as you go forth before your people, in your steps on the path of righteousness.
verses.9: The earth is in turmoil; the heavens have been destroyed by God. This is Zion, destroyed by God, the God of Israel.
verses.10: May God bless your inheritance, and may you be blessed, you who have created it.
verses.11: Your life will be spent there. You will prepare for the poor, O God, with your good deeds.
verses.12: Adonai, grant that those who speak will have a large army at their side.
verses.13: The kings of the heavens will be destroyed; they will be punished. And in that house, chaos will reign.
verses.14: If they are laid between their lips, like the wings of a swallow; their bodies are covered with gold, and their breasts are covered with wildflowers.
verses.15: In the days of kings, there will be snow in that land.
verses.16: Mount God, Mount Bashan, Mount Gabnunim, Mount Bashan.
verses.17: Why do you walk up the steep mountains? This mountain is a place where God will dwell forever. Even Jehovah will rest there for all eternity.
verses.18: The chariots of God are numerous; they number thousands. In them, the gods stand, in that holy day.
verses.19: You have gone into the wilderness; you have left your home. You have taken away our offerings from us. Even those who are sick and weak have been left behind. Oh God!
verses.20: Blessed be the Lord, who will bring us salvation today. May He deliver us from our troubles.
verses.21: The Lord has given us an advocate to help us; He is our refuge in times of death.
verses.22: But God will remove his enemies from him. Then, a door will be opened in his heart.
verses.23: “I said, ‘O Adonai from the heavens, I will rest in the depths of the sea.’”
verses.24: So that your feet may step on blood, like those of your dogs, from their enemies.
verses.25: We saw your movements, O God! Your movements were like those of my king in the holy day.
verses.26: They sang before the musicians, in the midst of a world of moving sounds.
verses.27: In their assemblies, God the LORD blessed Israel from all corners of the land.
verses.28: There, in Binyamin’s youth, there were the leaders of the Jews: Rigmat, Zevulun, and Naphtali.
verses.29: Your God has commanded you to do this. This is what God has told us to do.
verses.30: From your palace in Jerusalem, kings will bring you gifts.
verses.31: The life of the people of Canaan is destroyed by the actions of those who are filled with greed and selfishness. They are destroyed by the wealth of other nations.
verses.32: Let them be freed from my hands, from Egypt. Let them stretch out their hands to the gods.
verses.33: The kings of the earth will sing praises to God. They will praise Him, O Adonai!
verses.34: To ride in their names, those of the ancient ones will be given a loud voice.
verses.35: Give God the strength and courage to deal with Israel’s troubles and hardships.
verses.36: God appears from your holy place, O Israel. He gives strength and courage to the people, blessed be God.
